mutants.title: source setup again omits the entwurf operator command, so Copilot fresh rejects runtime-unresolved unless an unrelated global package happens to mask the defect
mutants.subject: scripts/dev-bin.sh

mutants.title: source setup reports green after the managed operator command is foreign, shadowed, or outside PATH, recreating the runtime-unresolved incident behind a cosmetic success
mutants.subject: run.sh
find:
if ! bash "$REPO_DIR/scripts/dev-bin.sh" verify entwurf; then
    return 1
  fi
replace:
if ! bash "$REPO_DIR/scripts/dev-bin.sh" verify entwurf; then
    return 0
  fi

mutants.title: an unreadable or wrong-shaped package manifest is read as zero bin names again, so the exclusivity check finds no other root by checking nothing and source setup reports a developer install

replace: bins = {}  # regressed: an unreadable manifest read as zero names
